text:
Samir Gupta: Quick idea 1: set up a 30-min 'Micromoments Kiosk' at the commuter lobby next Tue 8:15-8:45 to catch folks coming in. Small on-brand cards ("spotlights") + transit-sized sticker sheets, and a simple QR nomination. Budget up to $400. Who can grab 50 cards + 100 stickers Mon?
Nora Fields: I can pick up Mon AM if someone confirms vendor and address. Do we have a print-friendly PDF for the cards?
Ivy Lopez: I have the card PDF and can print 60 on cardstock at the office. Will laminate if needed. Where do you want the QR to point?
Samir Gupta: Link should be the short nom form: https://redwood.internal/micro-nom (3 fields max). Also want a 1-line sign: "Micromoments: recognize a tiny win". Keep signage A4.
Raj Patel: I can handle pickup Mon 10am (I9m near vendor). Which vendor and expense code?
Samir Gupta: Vendor: CityPrint Co (Dock 2). Expense code: POPUP-MICRO-2026. OpsBot can confirm policy?
OpsBot: Reminder: Pop-up expenses must be submitted within 7 days. Use code POPUP-MICRO-2026. Receipts required. Link: https://redwood.internal/expenses :page_facing_up:
Nora Fields: Great. @Raj can you grab a small box of 100 sticker sheets and 50 cards? Also request 20 QR sticker sheets to stick on signposts.
Raj Patel: Yep. Will grab 100 stickers, 60 cards, and QR sticker sheets. ETA Mon 10:05 pickup. My cell: 555-0234.
Ivy Lopez: I'll print 60 cards tonight and bring a cutter. Samir, do you want the cards numbered or blank?
Samir Gupta: Blank is fine. We'll pre-fill a tiny prompt on the back: "Why this moment mattered (one line)". Keep it quick for commuters.
Nora Fields: Volunteers for setup: I can do 8:00-9:00 shift. Need one more person to help hold the kiosk while I step away for a meeting 8:20-8:30.
Ivy Lopez: I can cover 8:20-8:40. I'll also bring a small ring-stand for the A4 sign and some double-stick tape.
Samir Gupta: Perfect. Can someone make a 3-field Google form (name, one-line reason, permission to post publicly)? Also QR short link and printed QR stickers.
Raj Patel: I'll generate the short link and the QR sheet at pickup.
OpsBot: Note: Recognition payouts are handled per policy; micro-spotlights under $25 are treated as swag, not taxable cash-equivalents, per the current rewards matrix. Check payroll link for details: https://redwood.internal/payroll/policy :clipboard:
Nora Fields: Good to know. We'll stick to enameled stickers and non-monetary cards to stay within swag.
Ivy Lopez: I'll attach the form link to the sign mockup and add inclusive language examples.
Samir Gupta: Calendar event please: "Micromoments Kiosk - Commuter Lobby" Tue 8:00-9:00 with volunteers Nora & Ivy. I'll post a short blurb in #general Tue morning.
Nora Fields: I'll scan and upload any filled cards to the recognition drive after the kiosk (scan folder: /drive/recognition/micromoments).
Samir Gupta: Thanks everyone. Reminder: submit pickup receipts and expense report within 7 days. I'll post the event and a 7am reminder on Tue. :sparkles:
